scope_note: The base PPO pretraining is shared; these are three independent fine-tuning seeds, not three independent PPO trainings from scratch.
test_acceptance: Each slow model should retain at least 95% safe-centered rate, median safe-centered duration at least 7.5 seconds, median absolute touchdown vy lower than the base PPO, and mean reward at least 200. Report score and switch-rate tradeoffs.
